notes: College of Arts and Humanities' Jewish Studies Four Year Academic Plan. The source PDF's term grid converts to garbled, column-interleaved text (the by-term grid and the separate requirements-checklist table run together), so exact per-slot Fall/Spring placement could not be reliably reconstructed; flagged in docs/project/owner-review.md. Term placement here follows the plan's legible signals (JWST187/171 in Year 1, JWST history/literature/thought Foundations courses across Years 1-2, JWST409/ISRL448 -- the Capstone -- in Year 4, and the General Jewish Studies Track's Area of Emphasis/electives in Years 3-4 as the plan lists them) and otherwise spreads the remaining major requirements across Years 2-4 in plan order. Gen Ed and general-elective slots are left out: only the major is audited.
Big Question filled with JWST187, named directly by the catalog and the plan.
Foundations (three courses from at least two areas) filled with JWST231 (History), JWST272 (Literature and/or Film), and JWST250 (Thought, Culture, and/or Religion), all named by the catalog.
Capstone filled with JWST409, named directly by the catalog and the plan.

Area of Emphasis (four 300-400 level courses, General Track) filled with JWST304, JWST309, JWST314, and JWST315, all real JWST courses from the Academic Catalog's approved-course list, chosen only to satisfy the level/credit shape (no per-area upper-level list is published; see Program reviewNotes).
In-Major Electives (three courses in Jewish Studies) filled with JWST219, JWST225, and JWST230, all real JWST courses from the Academic Catalog's approved-course list.
